A line break inside nested emphasis in a heading still separates the words on either side

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<h2><strong>Alpha</strong><strong><em><br></em></strong>Beta</h2>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
